hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && DIFF=$(git show --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B HEAD 2>/dev/null); jq -nc --arg diff "$DIFF" --arg msg "$MSG" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("A git commit just landed. Decide whether the project docs in `.claude/memory/*.md` (architecture, domain, data-layer, ui-layer, cloud-sync, build-and-run, conventions) and `docs/index.html` (features grid, architecture diagram, data-model diagram, stack, design system) need updating to reflect it.

Update docs if the commit touched: a new repository, a domain model or enum value, a new screen+ViewModel, the SQLDelight schema, a stack dependency, the OAuth/Drive flow, color tokens, or animation rules.

Skip if it was: a bug fix, copy/string tweak, refactor that kept public shape, tests, internal helper, version bump, or a change to the docs themselves.

If docs need a refresh, do it now (or surface what to change). Otherwise carry on silently.

Commit message:
" + $msg + "

Files touched:
" + $diff)}}'
